subject: ShellPkg/SerMode: Add name conversion arrays for parity/stop bits
reasons: Introduces lookup tables (arrays) to replace switch/if-else chains for name conversion in a single file (SerMode.c)
The restructuring replaces inline string comparisons with array-based lookups; this is a data-structure change, not a simple pattern substitution
Single-file change with no repeated instance of the same transformation across other files
Coccinelle cannot express the conversion of an if/switch chain to a data table lookup
